items.markdown:
Whether you are hunting for a museum-grade first edition or an affordable entry into antiquarian collecting, several trusted online marketplaces and specialized dealers can help you track down what you need:

### Major Search Engines & Aggregators



---

**viaLibri:** A powerful search engine that aggregates old, rare, and second-hand books across hundreds of global bookseller databases and auctions.

---

**AbeBooks:** A massive online marketplace connecting independent antiquarian, rare, and used booksellers worldwide.

---

**Biblio:** An independent marketplace specializing in antiquarian, out-of-print, and rare books from vetted booksellers.[[1]](https://www.vialibri.net/)

### Premier Antiquarian Dealers & Galleries



---

**Bauman Rare Books:** Known for an extensive inventory of high-end first editions, signed works, and historical autographs with galleries in New York and Las Vegas.

---

**The First Edition Rare Books:** Focuses heavily on landmark first editions and significant cultural, literary, and historical volumes.[[1]](https://www.baumanrarebooks.com/?srsltid=AYCX9vKReCbnkGmowbT1EpITVDFa5Qe-ujR05_LhowhluFit4qxj0DDb)[[2]](https://thefirstedition.com/)

Are you looking for a **specific author, title, or genre** (like Americana, science, or classic literature), or a **particular budget range** ? I can help point you toward specific editions or search strategies.
